System instruction execution and nonce account kind detection.

# Purpose
This C file implements execution logic for the Solana system program in the Firedancer runtime. It decodes `fd_system_program_instruction_t` values, checks account state and signatures, and applies system instruction behavior for account creation, assignment, allocation, and lamport transfer. The main entry point, [`fd_system_program_execute`](<#fd_system_program_execute>), reads the instruction data, decodes the system instruction, and dispatches to the matching handler such as [`fd_system_program_exec_create_account`](<#fd_system_program_exec_create_account>), [`fd_system_program_exec_assign`](<#fd_system_program_exec_assign>), [`fd_system_program_exec_transfer`](<#fd_system_program_exec_transfer>), and the seed-based variants.

The file also contains helper functions that support these handlers. [`verify_seed_address`](<#verify_seed_address>) re-derives a seeded address and checks that it matches the expected public key. [`fd_system_program_transfer_verified`](<#fd_system_program_transfer_verified>), [`fd_system_program_allocate`](<#fd_system_program_allocate>), [`fd_system_program_assign`](<#fd_system_program_assign>), and [`fd_system_program_create_account`](<#fd_system_program_create_account>) implement the core account updates and error checks used by the public instruction handlers. At the end of the file, [`fd_get_system_account_kind`](<#fd_get_system_account_kind>) inspects a transaction account and classifies it as a system account, nonce account, or unknown account based on owner, data length, and nonce state contents.
